A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same SwiReasoning work. Their text, equations, figures, tables, and appendices are readable, and relocated sections and renumbered tables can be reliably matched.

before.justification: v2 reports original benchmark evaluations, token-efficiency measurements, ablations, and diagnostic analyses in the main text and Appendix C.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results, including benchmark comparisons, ablations, and supplementary analyses.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Algorithm 1 retain the same entropy-guided switching, asymmetric dwell windows, signal mixing, and convergence/termination triggers. Expanded hyperparameter documentation does not establish a changed method.

E1.justification: All 11 benchmarks across mathematics, STEM, coding, and general reasoning were already evaluated in v2. The broader-domain experiments move from v2 Appendix C.3 to v3 Section 4.7; their coverage is unchanged.

E2.justification: Corresponding evaluations retain CoT with sampling, CoT with greedy decoding, and Soft Thinking. The relocated larger-model and broader-domain tables preserve their comparator membership.

E3.justification: The latency/TFLOPs experiment's stated model changes from 'Qwen-3B' in v2 Appendix C.4 to Qwen3-8B in v3 Appendix C.2. This is a limited reported model-setting correction; unchanged Figure 7 does not establish a rerun. Other added settings document existing experiments.

E4.justification: The window, mixing, switch-count, convergence-trigger, and no-latent ablations remain unchanged, as do exploration statistics, switch-count distributions, and the spatial-reasoning failure case. Appendix renumbering does not introduce new analyses.

E5.justification: Both versions specify eight repetitions and average accuracy for AIME 2024 and AIME 2025 in Appendix B.2. No changes to seed information, uncertainty reporting, or statistical estimation practices were found.

E6.justification: The abstract corrects the efficiency range from 56–79% to 57–79%, matching the unchanged Figure 2. Figure 1 reports regrouped domain summaries, and the headline accuracy range changes from 1.5–2.8% to 1.8–3.1%. Matched experimental result tables retain their values; these are summary changes, not demonstrated performance gains between versions.

T1.justification: The latent-embedding, entropy, switching, trigger, and efficiency definitions remain unchanged, as do their mathematical reasoning and Algorithm 1. No theoretical results or proofs are added or removed.

C1.justification: The abstract and contribution bullet now explicitly include coding and general reasoning alongside mathematics and STEM, and revise the headline numerical ranges. This broadens the emphasized empirical scope using existing appendix evidence; the training-free switching, count-control, and Pareto-efficiency contributions remain unchanged.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning exploration versus convergence, overthinking, problem difficulty, and component effects are retained. The limitation involving rigid geometric constraints also remains, moving from v2 Appendix C.6 to v3 Appendix C.4.

D1.justification: Appendix B.2 adds sample counts, dataset links, evaluation descriptions, and generation limits for six previously evaluated coding/general benchmarks. Appendix B.3 expands the hyperparameter table with Qwen3-32B and broader-task settings while preserving matched earlier entries. These additions improve documentation of existing experiments.

R1.justification: Appendix B.4 adds citations to Shi et al. (2023), UPop, and Yuan et al. (2025a), on forgetting between supervised and reinforcement learning. The positioning relative to training-free latent reasoning and complementary efficiency techniques remains unchanged.

P1.justification: v2 Appendices C.2–C.3 become v3 Sections 4.6–4.7, with corresponding scope statements and cross-references updated. Benchmark descriptions, acknowledgments, a conference header, and localized grammar edits are added; most prose and the overall narrative remain intact.

P2.justification: Figure 1 is redrawn with combined math/STEM summaries, Qwen3-32B, coding, and general reasoning panels. v2 Tables 5–6 move into the main text as v3 Tables 4–5, and the hyperparameter table gains rows and a model column. Other figures and table designs are largely retained.

improvement.justification: v3 makes existing larger-model and broader-domain evidence easier to find and supplies missing dataset and hyperparameter details in Appendices B.2–B.3. It also corrects the abstract's efficiency bound to agree with Figure 2. These provide useful clarity and reproducibility gains, while the method, experimental results, and validation remain essentially unchanged.
